about: Retrieval eval for showroom:eval. Most questions are phrased the way a salesperson would ask, deliberately avoiding the policy's own wording, and name the policy section that answers them. The last few use exact identifiers (policy codes, stock numbers, VINs), the case keyword search exists for. A question counts as a hit@k when the expected section or vehicle is in the top k results.
